title: The secoiridoid glycoside Gentiopicroside is a USP22 inhibitor with potent antitumor immunotherapeutic activity.
authors: Lu, Weiyuan; Chu, Peng; Tang, Amy; Si, Ligang; Fang, Deyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物龙胆苦苷作为USP22抑制剂增强抗肿瘤免疫，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Over the past decade, immunotherapies have brought about significant changes in how we approach the treatment of various solid tumors and blood-related cancers. However, the effectiveness of checkpoint blockade therapy has been constrained to a rate of under 30 %. A significant challenge in the realm of tumor immunotherapy revolves around comprehending the mechanisms through which regulatory T (Treg) cells induce immunosuppression. We have recently discovered that USP22 (ubiquitin-specific peptidase 22) a deubiquitinating enzyme that is increased in various tumors, is an oncogene and controls Treg immune suppressive activity for tumor evasion, providing a rationale for USP22 targeting to achieve both onco- and immuno-therapeutic efficacies. Herein, we identified the traditional Chinese secoiridoid compound gentiopicroside as a USP22 inhibitor. Gentiopicroside treatment decreased the forkhead box P3 (Foxp3) expression, which subsequently reduced Treg immune suppressive activity. Treatment of cancer cells by gentiopicroside resulted in an increase in histone 2B monoubiquitination (H2Bub) in a USP22-dependent manner and a decrease in programmed cell death ligand 1 (PD-L1) expression, both of which are known as USP22-specific substrates. Docking and molecular dynamic simulation revealed that gentiopicroside stably binds to USP22 catalytic pocket, supporting that gentiopicroside is a USP22 inhibitor. Importantly, administration of gentiopicroside to mice significantly inhibited the growth of syngenetic lung adenocarcinoma. Further analysis of intratumoral immune cells revealed a dramatic increase CD8(+) T cell production of IFN-gamma and granzyme B (GZMB), confirming that gentiopicroside enhances antitumor immunity. Our study revealed that gentiopicroside is a USP22-specific inhibitor with potent antitumor therapeutic potentials.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，免疫疗法显著改变了我们治疗多种实体瘤和血液相关癌症的方法。然而，检查点阻断疗法的有效性一直限制在30%以下。肿瘤免疫疗法领域的一个重大挑战在于理解调节性T（Treg）细胞诱导免疫抑制的机制。我们最近发现，USP22（泛素特异性肽酶22）——一种在多种肿瘤中表达升高的去泛素化酶——是一种癌基因，并控制Treg免疫抑制活性以促进肿瘤逃逸，这为靶向USP22以实现肿瘤治疗和免疫治疗双重疗效提供了理论依据。在此，我们鉴定出传统中药环烯醚萜类化合物龙胆苦苷（gentiopicroside）作为USP22抑制剂。龙胆苦苷处理降低了叉头框蛋白P3（Foxp3）的表达，进而减少了Treg免疫抑制活性。用龙胆苦苷处理癌细胞导致组蛋白2B单泛素化（H2Bub）以USP22依赖性方式增加，并降低程序性细胞死亡配体1（PD-L1）表达，这两者均为已知的USP22特异性底物。对接和分子动力学模拟显示，龙胆苦苷稳定结合于USP22催化口袋，支持龙胆苦苷是USP22抑制剂。重要的是，给小鼠施用龙胆苦苷显著抑制了同系肺腺癌的生长。对瘤内免疫细胞的进一步分析显示，CD8(+) T细胞产生干扰素-γ（IFN-gamma）和颗粒酶B（GZMB）显著增加，证实龙胆苦苷增强了抗肿瘤免疫。我们的研究表明，龙胆苦苷是一种USP22特异性抑制剂，具有强大的抗肿瘤治疗潜力。
